prompts.title: 概念字体海报 · 单字实验
prompts.summary: 海报是字体本身,字形即视觉,无任何装饰。
prompts.prompt:
Create ONE finished premium conceptual typography poster for the exact title:
"CHAOS".

Single poster only. No moodboard, grid, presentation board, mockup, captions, watermarks.
Typography is the hero. Design custom-looking letterforms whose weight, width, contrast, spacing, rhythm, distortion, negative space, edge quality, and ink texture express the temperament of the word CHAOS — fractured, layered, unpredictable.

Print on matte off-white paper, 4K, edge-to-edge bleed, soft natural paper grain.

prompts.title: 街头咖啡意外瞬间
prompts.summary: raw 纪实,真实液体扩散、颗粒、光线方向。

竖版手机纪实照片,主题:一杯热咖啡意外洒在纽约街头的人行道上。

主体:必须呈现真实的材质状态 —— 液体扩散形成不规则水洼,冰块散落滚动,纸杯压扁变形,蒸汽从液体升起,灰尘颗粒悬浮。

约束:不要插画、动漫、CGI、棚拍光、品牌文字、水印。场景真实可信,像手机抓拍。
